items.headline: Danaher subsidiary Masimo received FDA 510(k) clearance for an AI-enabled opioid-induced respiratory depression detection feature on its wearable patient monitor
Danaher completed its acquisition of Masimo, which will operate as a stand-alone company within Danaher’s Diagnostics segment
Danaher will host its second-quarter 2026 earnings conference call on July 21, 2026
